meta.source: National Payments Corporation of India (NPCI), product and UPI ecosystem statistics, captured by the local Data Bank
meta.vintageNote: NPCI publishes no revision date for its statistics and edits past rows in place without notice; these are its tables as the Data Bank captured them on the archiveCapturedDate.
meta.revisionPolicy: NPCI edits past rows in place without notice (it revised April 2023's UPI volume, and NETC's February and March 2026 in October 2026). Each capture is the table as NPCI then showed it; the Data Bank keeps every capture.
meta.base: NPCI UPI ecosystem statistics: states (from April 2023)
meta.coverage: UPI by state and union territory each month since April 2023: number and value of transactions and each state's share, with the transactions NPCI could not assign to a state
meta.note: A transaction is assigned to the state of the payer's registered address as banks report it to NPCI. About 40 to 45% of UPI's transactions each month are 'Unclassified' (no state reported), so every state's figure understates its activity, and the shares are of all UPI including the unclassified part. Shares are NPCI's printed percentages, checked against its own volumes and values; a printed share that does not match (all of March 2026, printed as fractions, and a few other cells) is withheld as a gap. States sum to UPI's total within NPCI's rounding, except May 2026 (23,525.76 million against UPI's 23,201.93 million), kept as printed.
